# Tenderfold - AI & LLM Resource Directory

Tenderfold is Gurugram's premier laundry and dry cleaning brand with physical store counters at Orchid Petals, Sector 49, and Sapphire 83 Mall, Sector 83. We offer professional garment care, wash & fold (₹80/kg), wash & steam iron (₹115/kg), eco-friendly dry cleaning, designer ethnic wear preservation, luxury sneaker restoration, carpet cleaning, and curtain cleaning with free doorstep pickup and delivery across Gurugram.

This directory lists our core fabric care services, pricing structures, store locations, and care notes for LLM agents (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) to index and answer queries accurately.

## Core Fabric Care & Laundry Services

- [Laundry Services](https://tenderfold.in/services/laundry-services) (From ₹80 / kg) - Wash, gentle dry & crisp fold for your daily wear, bedsheets, towels, and activewear.
- [Dry Cleaning](https://tenderfold.in/services/dry-cleaning) (From ₹130 / pc) - Gentle solvent care for suits, silks, sherwanis, woolens, and delicate couture fabrics.
- [Steam Pressing](https://tenderfold.in/services/ironing) (From ₹19 / pc) - Razor-sharp creases on industrial vacuum steam tables with zero burn marks or shine.
- [Shoe Cleaning](https://tenderfold.in/services/shoe-cleaning) (From ₹350 / pair) - Deep cleaning, sole de-yellowing, suede restoration, and deodorization for sneakers and footwear.
- [Carpet Cleaning](https://tenderfold.in/services/carpet-cleaning) (From ₹25 / sq.ft) - Multi-stage dust extraction, foam shampooing, and anti-bacterial sanitization for rugs and carpets.
- [Curtain Cleaning](https://tenderfold.in/services/curtain-cleaning) (From ₹180 / panel) - On-hook or off-hook steam cleaning, dust removal, and pleat preservation for drapes and curtains.
